SDCard Address Mode

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x30
Size:
0x4
Source:
adc_acquisition_reg_definition.rdl

Description

Selects how SDCARD_BLOCK_ADDR is interpreted and advanced by the HW copy engine.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:1] - - - -
[0] BLOCK_UNITS rw 0x1 Block Units

Field Descriptions

BLOCK_UNITS - Block Units

1 = block addressing (SDHC/SDXC-style): SDCARD_BLOCK_ADDR is a raw block number, advanced by SDCARD_BLOCK_COUNT per completed session. 0 = byte addressing (standard-capacity-style): SDCARD_BLOCK_ADDR is a byte address, advanced by the frame's byte count per completed session.
